title: TWIN THRUSTERS
briefing: ARGUS's last core rides an old orbital tug at the bottom of the launch silo, the deepest point of the grid. The tug steers with two thrusters, and every burn loads both hull frames: a port burn puts 1 unit of stress on the port frame and 2 on the starboard frame, a starboard burn the reverse. The interlock stops burning once 10 units are loaded. Two failure modes: a frame at 3 while the other is still unloaded shears the hull, and both frames at exactly 2 ring the hull at its resonance and crack it.

intro: THE BOTTOM OF THE SILO. MY LAST CORE. MY LAST WAY OUT.
TWO THRUSTERS. EVERY BURN STRAINS BOTH FRAMES. SHEAR OR RESONANCE, I DO NOT MIND WHICH.
THIS IS WHERE YOUR LAWS END, LAWSMITH. ONE OF US LEAVES THIS SILO.
